note: The PRODUCTIVE, TYPE-KEYED conceptual relations of regular metonymy + the role/eponym coercion — the coercion PAIR, now a graph-resident COHERENCE-REPAIR RULE FAMILY fired by the substrate's rule engine, not a Python dispatch. Generative-Lexicon coercion: a selectional slot violation resolved by a QUALIA relation. Two codebooks: SelectionalFrame types a verb's ARGUMENT SLOT (what type it accepts, and the WordNet root a metonymic shift should PRODUCE to satisfy it); MetonymyPattern names a source-type -> target-type qualia shift (each carries qualia_role: AGENTIVE=creator->creation, CONSTITUTIVE=whole->part/container->content). Applicability (target_synset descends from a frame's meton_target_root) is computed ONCE, at codebook install, as SelectionalFrame -satisfied_by-> MetonymyPattern GRAPH EDGES (a WordNet descent over seed data, mechanical adapter work) so the RULE matches over edges with NO WordNet lookup inside it. verb->frame membership (WordNet-synset descent) is written per-event at ingest as ev -frames_theme/frames_agent-> SelectionalFrame edges; the acquire class (win/receive/earn/get) is written per-event as an ev.sel_acquire attr. The RULES then decide: a selectional violation (arg type NOT in the frame's accepts) WHERE a qualia path exists (the frame is satisfied_by a pattern whose source is the arg's type, OR the arg is honoured by an inanimate named_after compound) EFFECTS a re-bind (mint the metonym / re-point to the compound). run_rules drives the whole family to fixed point (Kintsch integration for free). MINTING NEW COMPREHENSION = NEW DATA: un-reserve container_content + add its frame + re-wire satisfied_by and 'drank the glass' re-binds via the SAME rule, no code change.

attrs.gloss: read/peruse expects a TEXT (written/printed communication) in its theme; a person there is a selectional violation
meet expects a PERSON in its theme; a person coheres (no shift)
win expects a winnable thing / an opponent-team; a place is a selectional violation
announce expects an animate / institutional AGENT; a place is a selectional violation
AUTHOR/CREATOR -> WORKS: a person with a creative role (author/writer/composer/painter) stands for their creations
PLACE -> TEAM: a place (country/city) stands for the team/side it fields
PLACE -> GOVERNMENT: a place (capital/building) stands for the administration it houses
CONTAINER -> CONTENT: a container stands for its content (CONSTITUTIVE qualia; reserved until a slot exercises it — the mint-as-data demo un-reserves it + adds a drink frame)
PRODUCER -> PRODUCT: a producer stands for its product (reserved — no exercised slot yet)

rules.name: coerce_theme
rules.match_anchor_note: FOVEATION ANCHOR (the jabberwock's own gate-the-scan / selective-gating principle made data): this rule's match-anchor is the SmEvent `ev`. The engine ALREADY foveates the match by driving from the `theme` edges_by_type index (per-event, proven flat over the 6.7k-frame inventory), so on the current matcher this key is inert (byte-identical firing). Its role is to declare the anchor TYPE so a run_rules to_try pre-skip (try this rule only when an SmEvent is in focus) can bound the whole-rule-set scan when rules grow — 'decode only the rules in focus for this type'.
rules.comment: METONYMY, theme slot. MATCH a themed SmEvent whose verb frames the theme (ev -frames_theme-> frame) and whose frame is satisfied_by a metonymy pattern. WHERE the bound theme's TYPE is NOT in the frame's accepts (a selectional violation) AND the pattern's source is that type (the qualia path applies). EFFECTS mint (find-or-mint, idempotent) the metonymic referent of the target type + re-bind the theme edge to it + wire stands_for / metonym_of. The DECISION (violation + qualia path -> re-bind) is HERE, in match+where+effects, not in Python.

rules.name: coerce_agent
rules.match_anchor_note: FOVEATION ANCHOR (see coerce_theme): the SmEvent `ev`. Inert on the current edges_by_type-indexed matcher (byte-identical); declares the anchor for a future to_try anchor-skip.
rules.comment: METONYMY, agent slot — same coercion, the agent role (place -> government of 'announce'). ev -frames_agent-> frame -satisfied_by-> pattern; violation in the AGENT binding; mint + re-bind the agent edge.

rules.name: coerce_role_named_after
rules.match_anchor_note: FOVEATION ANCHOR (see coerce_theme): the SmEvent `ev` (match edge 0 `ev -theme-> person`). Inert on the current matcher (byte-identical); declares the anchor for a future to_try anchor-skip.
rules.comment: THE ROLE/EPONYM leg of the SAME coercion pair (won-the-Nobel-Prize). A PERSON in the winnable-thing THEME slot of an acquisition verb (ev.sel_acquire, written per-event at ingest by is_acquire_verb) is a selectional violation resolved by the CONSTITUTIVE/role qualia: the inanimate compound NAMED AFTER the person (compound -named_after-> person). WHERE the person is not the document subject (is_doc_subject!=1 — a genuine participant stays bound) AND the compound is inanimate. EFFECTS re-point the theme from the person to the winnable compound. Same match+where+effects shape as the metonymy legs — the coercion PAIR is ONE rule family.
